CREATE TABLE "public"."Account" (
  "accessToken" text,
  "accessTokenExpiresAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "password" character varying(128),
  "provider" "AccountProvider" NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "scope" character varying(500),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Account_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AiReport" (
  "aiSummary" text NOT NULL,
  "aiTips" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "categoryBreakdown" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dayPatterns" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "generatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "hasActivity" bool NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "locale" character varying(10) DEFAULT 'ko' NOT NULL,
  "period" int4 NOT NULL,
  "stats" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "timePatterns" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "type" "ReportType" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "AiReport_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Cheer" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" character varying(200),
  "readAt" timestamp(3),
  "receiverId" text NOT NULL,
  "senderId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Cheer_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DailyCompletion" (
  "achievedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "completedTodos" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "totalTodos" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "DailyCompletion_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Follow" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "followerId" text NOT NULL,
  "followingId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" "FollowStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"FollowStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Follow_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."LoginAttempt" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "failureReason" character varying(100),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45) NOT NULL,
  "provider" "AccountProvider",
  "success" bool NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "LoginAttempt_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Memo" (
  "content" character varying(5000) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isPinned" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Memo_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Notification" (
  "actionType" "NotificationActionType" DEFAULT 'DEEP_LINK'::"NotificationActionType" NOT NULL,
  "actionUrl" character varying(1000),
  "body" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "campaignKey" character varying(100),
  "cheerId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "friendId" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isRead" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "notificationDate" date,
  "nudgeId" int4,
  "openedAt" timestamp(3),
  "purpose" "NotificationPurpose" DEFAULT 'TRANSACTIONAL'::"NotificationPurpose" NOT NULL,
  "readAt" timestamp(3),
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "todoId" int4,
  "type" "NotificationType" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "variantId" character varying(100),
  CONSTRAINT "Notification_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Notification_todo_comment_action_url_check" CHECK (((type <> 'TODO_SHARED'::"NotificationType") OR ("actionType" <> 'DEEP_LINK'::"NotificationActionType") OR ((metadata ->> 'commentId'::text) IS NULL) OR ("actionUrl" IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "Notification_todo_comment_sender_check" CHECK ((((metadata ->> 'commentId'::text) IS NULL) OR COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((metadata -> 'senderId'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (length((metadata ->> 'senderId'::text)) > 0)), false)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Nudge" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" character varying(200),
  "readAt" timestamp(3),
  "receiverId" text NOT NULL,
  "repliedAt" timestamp(3),
  "replyKind" "NudgeReplyKind",
  "replyUpdatedAt" timestamp(3),
  "senderId" text NOT NULL,
  "thankedAt" timestamp(3),
  "todoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Nudge_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."OAuthState" (
  "accessToken" character varying(1000),
  "accountRestored" bool,
  "codeVerifier" character varying(128),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "exchangeCode" character varying(64),
  "exchangedAt" timestamp(3),
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "initiatingUserId" character varying(36),
  "ipAddress" character varying(45),
  "mode" character varying(10),
  "profileImage" character varying(500),
  "provider" "AccountProvider" NOT NULL,
  "redirectUri" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" character varying(1000),
  "state" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" character varying(500),
  "userId" character varying(255),
  "userName" character varying(20),
  CONSTRAINT "OAuthState_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PushDailyBudget" (
  "automatedCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastSentAt" timestamp(3),
  "localDate" date NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PushDailyBudget_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PushDeliveryAttempt" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dispatchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "errorCode" character varying(100),
  "errorMessage" character varying(500),
  "expoTicketId" character varying(100),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "pushTokenId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "receiptCheckedAt" timestamp(3),
  "status" "PushDeliveryStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PushDeliveryStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PushDeliveryAttempt_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PushDispatch" (
  "campaignKey" character varying(100),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveryAttemptCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastError" character varying(500),
  "localDate" date,
  "notificationId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "openedAt" timestamp(3),
  "processingJobAttempt" int4,
  "processingJobId" character varying(255),
  "processingStartedAt" timestamp(3),
  "purpose" "NotificationPurpose" NOT NULL,
  "rateLimitReservedAt" timestamp(3),
  "scheduledAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "sentAt" timestamp(3),
  "skipReason" character varying(100),
  "status" "PushDispatchStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PushDispatchStatus" NOT NULL,
  "timezone" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "variantId" character varying(100),
  CONSTRAINT "PushDispatch_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PushDispatchOutbox" (
  "availableAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveryMode" "PushDeliveryMode" NOT NULL,
  "dispatchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "force" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastError" character varying(500),
  "lockedAt" timestamp(3),
  "publishAttempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamp(3),
  "status" "PushDispatchOutboxStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PushDispatchOutboxStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PushDispatchOutbox_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("dispatchId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PushRateLimitReservation" (
  "dispatchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "localDate" date,
  "phase" "PushRateLimitPhase" NOT NULL,
  "reservedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PushRateLimitReservation_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("dispatchId", "phase")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PushToken" (
  "appVersion" character varying(30),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lastUsedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "payloadVersion" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "platform" "Platform" NOT NULL,
  "token" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PushToken_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RecurringSuggestion" (
  "confidence" float8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "daysOfWeek" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "matchedTodos" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduledTime" text,
  "status" "SuggestionStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"SuggestionStatus" NOT NULL,
  "suggestedCategoryId" int4,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RecurringSuggestion_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ReminderNudge" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" character varying(200),
  "receiverId" text NOT NULL,
  "senderId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "ReminderNudge_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RetentionExperimentAssignment" (
  "assignedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "experimentKey" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamp(3),
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "variant" "RetentionExperimentVariant" NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RetentionExperimentAssignment_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RetentionExperimentResult" (
  "assignmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "measuredAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "returnedWithinD7" bool NOT NULL,
  "todoActionWithinD7" bool NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RetentionExperimentResult_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RetentionExperimentStage" (
  "assignmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notificationId" int4,
  "processedAt" timestamp(3),
  "skipReason" character varying(100),
  "stage" "RetentionExperimentStageName" NOT NULL,
  "status" "RetentionExperimentStageStatus" DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED'::"RetentionExperimentStageStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RetentionExperimentStage_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RetentionPushOutbox" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "availableAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dispatchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastError" character varying(500),
  "lockedAt" timestamp(3),
  "notificationId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamp(3),
  "stageId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "RetentionOutboxStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"RetentionOutboxStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RetentionPushOutbox_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SecurityLog" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event" "SecurityEvent" NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45) NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "userAgent" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  CONSTRAINT "SecurityLog_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Session" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceFingerprint" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45) NOT NULL,
  "lastUsedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "previousTokenHash" character varying(64),
  "refreshTokenHash" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamp(3),
  "revokedReason" character varying(200),
  "tokenFamily" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "tokenVersion" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Session_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Subscription" (
  "cancelledAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataRetentionUntil" timestamp(3),
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastProcessedEventId" character varying(255),
  "productId" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "revenueCatId" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "status" "SubscriptionStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Subscription_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Todo" (
  "categoryId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "commentCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "completed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endDate" date,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isAllDay" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "recurrenceGroupId" character varying(36),
  "scheduledTime" timestamptz(3),
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" date NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "viewCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "visibility" "TodoVisibility" DEFAULT 'PUBLIC'::"TodoVisibility" NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Todo_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TodoCategory" (
  "color" character varying(7) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "TodoCategory_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TodoComment" (
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "clientRequestId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "content" character varying(500),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "depth" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "editedAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "likeCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "parentId" text,
  "path" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "replyCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "requestFingerprint" character(64),
  "rootId" text,
  "todoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "TodoComment_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TodoCommentLike" (
  "commentId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "notifiedAt" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "TodoCommentLike_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("commentId", "userId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TodoItem" (
  "completed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "todoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "TodoItem_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TodoView" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "todoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "viewerId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "TodoView_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("todoId", "viewerId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "aiUsageCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "aiUsageResetAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastActiveAt" timestamp(3),
  "lastLoginAt" timestamp(3),
  "revenueCatUserId" character varying(255),
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'USER'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "status" "UserStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING_VERIFY'::"UserStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subscriptionExpiresAt" timestamp(3),
  "subscriptionStatus" "SubscriptionStatus" DEFAULT 'FREE'::"SubscriptionStatus" NOT NULL,
  "twoFactorEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "twoFactorSecret" character varying(255),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userTag" character varying(8) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "User_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserActivityDay" (
  "firstSeenAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "localDate" date NOT NULL,
  "timezone" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "UserActivityDay_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserConsent" (
  "agreedTermsVersion" character varying(20),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "marketingAgreedAt" timestamp(3),
  "marketingPushAgreedAt" timestamp(3),
  "privacyAgreedAt" timestamp(3),
  "termsAgreedAt" timestamp(3),
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "UserConsent_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserLocation" (
  "gridX" int4 NOT NULL,
  "gridY" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "UserLocation_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserPreference" (
  "currentStreak" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "eveningReminderHour" int4 DEFAULT 19 NOT NULL,
  "eveningReminderMinute" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastCompletedDate" date,
  "locale" character varying(10) DEFAULT 'ko' NOT NULL,
  "longestStreak" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "morningReminderHour" int4 DEFAULT 8 NOT NULL,
  "morningReminderMinute" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "nightPushEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "pushEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "timeFormat" "TimeFormat" DEFAULT 'TWELVE_HOUR'::"TimeFormat" NOT NULL,
  "timezone" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "weatherEveningEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "weatherEveningHour" int4 DEFAULT 17 NOT NULL,
  "weatherEveningMinute" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "weatherMorningEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "weatherMorningHour" int4 DEFAULT 7 NOT NULL,
  "weatherMorningMinute" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "UserPreference_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserProfile" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(20),
  "profileImage" character varying(500),
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "UserProfile_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Verification" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "token" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "type" "VerificationType" NOT NULL,
  "usedAt" timestamp(3),
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Verification_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WeeklyAchievement" (
  "achievedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "completedTodos" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "totalTodos" int4 NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "week" int4 NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "WeeklyAchievement_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
